headline: Spotify launches paid Memberships program for podcast creators
summary: Spotify has launched a paid Memberships feature that lets podcast creators offer fans exclusive perks in exchange for payment. First announced in May, the program is rolling out in 34 regions, with creators keeping 90% of the revenue, a split one outlet says is comparable to Patreon's.
